description: This file defines a Java interface 'DittoHeadersBuilder' which provides a fluent API for constructing 'DittoHeaders' objects. It includes methods for setting various header properties such as correlation ID, schema version, authorization context, content type, ETags, response types, acknowledgements, timeouts, metadata, and arbitrary headers.

classes.name: DittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A Java interface providing a fluent API for building 'DittoHeaders' objects with various configurable headers and properties.

methods.name: correlationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID header; can be null or empty.

methods.name: randomCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates and sets a random UUID as the correlation ID.

methods.name: schemaVersion
methods.description: Sets the JSON schema version header.

methods.name: authorizationContext
methods.description: Sets the authorization context header.

methods.name: authorizationSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated: Sets authorization subject IDs; use authorizationContext instead.

methods.name: authorizationSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated: Sets authorization subjects; use authorizationContext instead.

methods.name: readSubjects
methods.description: Deprecated: Sets read subjects; use readGrantedSubjects instead.

methods.name: readGrantedSubjects
methods.description: Sets subjects with granted read access.

methods.name: readRevokedSubjects
methods.description: Sets subjects with revoked read access.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Sets the channel for signals or exceptions.

methods.name: responseRequired
methods.description: Sets whether a response is explicitly required.

methods.name: dryRun
methods.description: Sets the dry run flag.

methods.name: origin
methods.description: Sets the origin header.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the content type header as a string.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the content type header with a ContentType object.

methods.name: eTag
methods.description: Sets the ETag header.

methods.name: ifMatch
methods.description: Sets the If-Match header with entity tags.

methods.name: ifNoneMatch
methods.description: Sets the If-None-Match header with entity tags.

methods.name: inboundPayloadMapper
methods.description: Sets the inbound payload mapper ID.

methods.name: replyTarget
methods.description: Sets the reply target identifier.

methods.name: expectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Sets expected response types as varargs.

methods.name: expectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Sets expected response types as a collection.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Sets a collection of acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Sets a single acknowledgement request with optional additional requests.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets timeout using a string representation.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets timeout using a Duration object.

methods.name: putMetadata
methods.description: Adds or replaces metadata key-value pair.

methods.name: allowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Sets the allow policy lockout flag.

methods.name: putHeader
methods.description: Adds or replaces a header with string key and value.

methods.name: putHeaders
methods.description: Adds or replaces multiple headers from a map.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header by key.

methods.name: removePreconditionHeaders
methods.description: Removes all precondition headers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the 'DittoHeaders' object.
